Role-owned lows stay with their owners: D003-D005 (R09 f895c30), D008 (R05 e477e5d; R05 head re-delivered). A new R10 run on this CODE_SHA is the next acceptance step.

decisions.decision: Single transport: R01 CivicGateway with an explicit route table for all roles; unknown -> 404 JSON, undelivered module -> 503 module_unavailable.

Services receive the full path /api/civic/v1/..., raw query string, context {headers, cookies, client_ip, host_allowed=True, is_same_origin True/False/None, is_https=False} (R02 convention). R02 CivicHttpAdapter not used.
Publication model follows R02: edits of a published object stay in the staff copy until 'publish' with a public reason; residents never see unpublished edits.
R06 contract_delta routes accepted as compatible additions.
Mode switch Город (default) / Школы / Учебная модель on the same MapLibre instance; training and school modes unchanged.
R07 read-only GET /scenarios/graphs, /scenarios/graphs/{id}, /scenarios/cases accepted; graph files never served as static assets; compare limited to 2 concurrent runs.
Login requests are serialised in the gateway until R02 makes the rate-limit check atomic (R02 review M1); DB file chmod 0600, .runtime 0700.
R01 fallback modules (fallback.js) removed after R03/R04/R06 integration: one implementation per function; a missing module is shown as such.
R09 POST /staff/assistant/extract accepted; gateway enforces staff session+CSRF before R09. Assistant facts only from R02 public view and R07 prepared cases; no LLM provider configured.

Resident-message moderation is a separate staff-only drawer (button visible only with an editor session), per R06 r01_integration.patch; editor, moderation and scenario drawers are mutually exclusive.

.dockerignore edited by R01 (outside the listed R01 paths) to keep runtime SQLite with password hashes out of images (R10-D001, R02 review). Coordinator may move this to the owner of deployment files.
Gateway service registry uses an RLock: dependent factories (feedback/assistant need store) no longer deadlock on lazy start (found by tests/civic/R01/test_r01_integrated_routes.py).
Feedback object lookup is composed by R01: R02 public object first, staff copy only when no public version exists (C13; matches R02 INTEGRATION §0a).

Integration CSS adapters live only in web/civic/shell/shell.css, scoped to the shell's containers, labelled with the owner and removed when the owner fixes it (R03 adapter removed after 3cea09c; R04 action-bar adapter open).
Phones: panel and drawers are bottom sheets; with a drawer open the panel is hidden (visibility) so the map strip above the drawer stays usable; attribution is lifted above the sheet/drawer.
